bmc-headless-browser.label: Default BMC login
bmc-headless-browser.description: Store your BMC login privately. Browser runtime integration is pending; saving does not log in or contact the BMC.

bmc-html5-kvm.label: Default console login
bmc-html5-kvm.description: Private console login setup. KVM runtime integration is pending; no credentials are automatically shared with the browser or other skills.

ipmi-redfish-bmc.label: Default management login
ipmi-redfish-bmc.description: Eligible for an explicitly scoped read-only Redfish connection after runtime activation. Requires a trusted HTTPS certificate with the private IPv4 address in its SAN. IPMI, SOL and server changes are not supported by this adapter.
